C1509.title: VR Escape Room Game Steals 25 Personal Data Points in Experiment
C1509.summary: A privacy study involving 50 participants playing a seemingly harmless VR escape room game found that an adversarial program accurately inferred over 25 personal attributes, including height, arm span, age, and gender, within minutes.
